sentences.text: The evidence shows the hypothetical APR illustration uses a loan amount of ₹20,000, but it does not state the net disbursed amount as a separate figure.
The in-force directions say APR is computed on the net disbursed amount using the IRR approach, but they do not provide the net disbursed amount in the cited illustration.

missing.searched: Searched the RBI KFS APR illustration and the in-force UCB APR disclosure text for an explicit net disbursed amount; found only the loan amount and the rule that APR is computed on the net disbursed amount.
